ref_date_note: Wed 9/3/2025 (posted Tue 9/2, after the large 9/2 gap down and GOOGL after-hours rally). U (Sep 2025) contract, no roll mention. 'Trades:' section is UNGRADED (all tags ''); its three sentences each name several levels, so they are split into one trade per level (quote = whole sentence). No targets stated in Trades -> taken from Trading Higher/Lower: es1 -> 6444.5, 6451-6454, 6455.5 (his 'broadly targets Friday's 6455.5 low', mindful of the other two); nq1/nq2 -> 23342-23369 then 23397.5 (= last week's and Friday's low); nq3 -> 23205-23220 VPOC magnet then 23146-23162; es2 -> 6396 then 6376-6382 and today's low (RTH_LOW). Failed-reclaim shorts (es3-es5, nq4-nq5): he says joining a session downtrend 'within that range' (the LVN between 6451/6460 and 6431-6435) -> ES targets step down to 6431-6435 (es3 adds the spike 6425-6427.75); nq5 -> 23342-23369; nq4 (below the LVN) -> first NQ level down 23252-23271 then 23205-23220 (he deliberately did not use the 23280-23290.25 spike as a level). nq2 gate taken literally as 23280-23290 (spike defined earlier as 23280-23290.25). Typos: '2342-23438' read as 23425-23438; NQ Trading Lower says 'Holding below 23352 invites weakness' (possibly meant 23252 or the 23342-23369 spot; kept 23352 as a zone only). Big-picture NQ downside 22100-22200 (break next week) / ~22369 (break this week) kept as zones. 6502.5 = 8/13 high.
